title: Marketing and BDM Manager
description:
Marketing and BDM Manager

Our fantastic client in Quedgeley (Gloucester), a leading manufacturer of construction equipment parts is currently looking for a Marketing Manager to join their small, busy team on a permanent basis.

Hours: 36h per week. You can choose from the following two options:

Monday - Thursday (8am - 6pm)

OR

Monday - Thursday (8am - 4pm) + Friday (8am - 1pm)

Salary: Circa £30,000 per annum - negotiable depending on experience

The Marketing Manager is solely responsible for all marketing activities across the company, with a primary focus on the flagship brand. This includes strategy, social media management, content creation, event support and maintaining communications with distributors. You will be fully trained on the company products. Whilst you will 'manage' the marketing function- you will not be responsible for line managing any other staff.

Responsibilities
- Develop and implement marketing strategies for new products and brands, using performance analytics to monitor and optimise results.
- Monitor industry trends and competitor activity to inform strategy.
- Manage digital marketing activity, including social media, email campaigns, website content, SEO and blog publishing.
- Plan and deliver trade shows, events and open days, providing marketing materials and on-site support to the sales team.
- Support onboarding and ongoing engagement with distributors (dealers), including vetting, onboarding, training coordination, resource management and maintaining the portal.
- Produce and maintain promotional materials including brochures, technical documentation and sales resources, ensuring accuracy and brand consistency.
- Lead branding and positioning for new product launches and group businesses.
- Create and manage high-quality content, including photography, videography, case studies and product libraries.
- Manage relationships with industry partners and produce advertorial and feature content for trade publications.

Key Attributes
- Previous working experience within marketing or sales support (2yrs+)
- Confident using the computer/social media
- Team player
- Good time management skills
- Driving licence ideal (for site visits) not essential

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Performance Marketing Manager

Are you a commercially minded performance marketer who knows how to turn paid media investment into quality leads and measurable results?

This opportunity offers ownership of established B2 C acquisition activity, working across paid search and paid social, improving campaign performance, reduce cost per lead and maximise return on investment.

Operating between the business and external delivery agency, you have the opportunity to drive innovation and new thinking to make a tangible impact at pace.

The role
- Manage and optimise a £1.5m annual paid media budget across paid channels.
- Drive performance across Google Ads and Meta, with opportunities to develop activity across TikTok, Microsoft/Bing and emerging platforms.
- Generate quality enquiries, improve conversion rates and reduce acquisition costs.
- Test audiences, creative, ad formats and landing pages to identify what delivers the strongest results.
- Use GA4, Looker Studio and Google Tag Manager, alongside Funnel reporting, to turn campaign data into clear actions.
- Work with agency partners and internal marketing, digital, creative and CRM teams to deliver coordinated campaigns.
- Support organic acquisition through keyword insights, content optimisation and local SEO.
- Provide clear reporting on spend, lead quality, conversion and return on investment.

What you'll bring
- Experience as a Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Media Manager or Digital Acquisition Manager, gained agency or client side.
- Strong hands-on Google Ads and Meta experience, ideally B2 C lead generation.
- Confidence managing significant budgets, explaining commercial impact
- Analytical approach, with a track record of using data and testing to improve results.
- Strong stakeholder and agency management skills.
- Working knowledge of SEO; experience with SEO platforms would be useful.
- The ability to pick up established campaigns quickly, maintain momentum and identify opportunities for improvement.

Why consider it?
- A substantial paid media budget with clear commercial objectives.
- Broad exposure across B2 C acquisition channels.

Interested? Apply with your CV or contact us for a confidential conversation.

title: PR Account Manager

PR Account Manager

Gloucestershire Hybrid 3 days in office - 2 remote Full-time

£33k - £40k

We're recruiting for a highly regarded PR and communications agency with a strong reputation across the UK's rural and country sector, working with brands and businesses spanning equine, canine, farming, country sports, outdoor and lifestyle.

They're looking for an Account Manager to join their growing team, but would also consider someone at Junior Account Manager level for the right person.

It's a varied role across PR, digital and social, with plenty of opportunity to get stuck into creative campaigns, build great client relationships and make your mark.

The role
- Managing day-to-day client relationships and accounts
- Planning and delivering PR campaigns
- Creating strong stories, content and media opportunities
- Digital PR, outreach and link building
- Organic and paid social media
- Building relationships with journalists, influencers and creators
- Supporting campaign strategy and new business

About you

You'll have experience in PR or communications, ideally agency-side, although we're open to hearing from candidates at both Account Manager and Junior Account Manager level.

You'll be a strong communicator and writer, organised, commercially minded and full of ideas. You'll enjoy working with clients, juggling multiple projects and getting stuck into the detail.

Knowledge of, or a genuine passion for, the countryside, equine, canine, farming, country sports, outdoor pursuits or country lifestyle would be a real plus. You don't need to have worked in the sector. An authentic interest and understanding is what matters.

Full-time Permanent only

Interested? Get in touch with Moxie & Mettle ASAP.

title: PR Account Manager - inhouse or agency welcome!
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
PR Account Manager

We are looking for a PR Account Manager to join an established communications agency, working across a varied portfolio of clients and sectors.

Our lovely client is happy to look at somebody who works clientside in PR/comms as well as an agency, though you will need to have worked on multiple campaigns at one time and also have been involved with budget planning, as this is a crucial part of the PR account management role.

About You

Some previous PR/communications experience is essential, from agency OR clientside.
- Involvement with budget allocation and planning
- Ability to handle multiple campaigns at one time
- Obviously excellent written communication skills
- The ability to turn complex information into clear, engaging stories
- Ambition and drive to progress your PR career!

The Opportunity

You're rejoining an incredibly collaborative and supportive team whether there is an outstanding culture with clear path for progression and development within the next 12 to 18 months.

You'll be office based three times a week, but the other two days can be remote, and you will also benefit from flexible start times, so for example, your working pattern could 8am-4pm or 10am-6pm or anything in between those hours - which makes your work/life balance a lot easier!

The Role

As an Account Manager, you will take responsibility for managing client accounts and delivering effective communications activity that supports their wider business objectives.

You will work closely with clients to understand their priorities, develop creative ideas and identify opportunities to raise their profile with relevant audiences.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of clients.
- Developing and delivering integrated PR and communications campaigns.
- Providing strategic communications advice and recommendations.
- Identifying compelling stories, angles and opportunities for clients.
- Building relationships with journalists and securing relevant media coverage.
- Writing and editing press releases, features, articles, case studies and other content.
- Supporting digital and social media activity where appropriate.
- Managing multiple projects, deadlines and budgets.
- Briefing and supporting junior members of the team.
- Monitoring campaign results and reporting back to clients.
- Keeping up to date with news, media trends and developments relevant to clients.
